book.title: Rib-related Pain: Rib Dysfunction, Costochondritis and Rib Fracture

blocks.text: Ribs attach to the spine at the back (costovertebral and costotransverse joints) and to the sternum at the front through cartilage (costochondral and sternocostal joints). Pain can arise at either end.

items: **Costochondritis**: tenderness at the front cartilage joints, usually of ribs 2 to 5, without swelling. Common and benign, but a diagnosis of exclusion because chest pain must first be screened for cardiac causes. **Tietze syndrome**: similar, but with visible swelling, usually at a single joint.
**Rib dysfunction** (posterior rib joint pain): one-sided pain beside the thoracic spine, worse with deep breath, twisting or lying on it.

**Rib fracture**: after trauma, or after coughing in osteoporosis; sharp localised pain worse with breathing. **Slipping rib syndrome**: lower ribs (8 to 10) move abnormally, producing a click and pain at the lower ribcage.

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Chest pain with sweating, breathlessness, arm or jaw radiation
Sudden breathlessness after trauma, reduced breath sounds
Multiple rib fractures, paradoxical chest movement
Fracture after minimal force in older adult

steps: **Chest pain?** Screen cardiac and respiratory causes first.
**Localised reproducible pain, no systemic or exertional features:** working diagnosis musculoskeletal chest wall pain (costochondritis or rib dysfunction).

items: **Education** is the main treatment for costochondritis: it is benign, often settles over weeks to months [Ref – to verify].
**Manual therapy**: posterior rib and thoracic mobilisation for rib dysfunction; avoid direct pressure on acute fractures.
**Exercise**: thoracic mobility, deep breathing, gradual upper body loading; temporarily reduce provoking activities (for example heavy pushing).
**Rib fracture**: pain control (doctor), deep breathing exercises every hour while awake, supported cough (hug a pillow), early walking to prevent chest infection. Do not bind the chest tightly.
**Modalities**: heat or ice for comfort; not essential.

sections.title: L to M. Management and reassessment

blocks.text: Track pain with deep breath, palpation tenderness, and function. Fractures usually heal over about 6 weeks [Ref – to verify]; progress upper body loading after pain settles.

items: **Is reproduction on palpation enough to diagnose costochondritis?** No. Cardiac causes must be excluded first in at-risk adults.
**Why encourage deep breathing after a rib fracture?** Shallow breathing increases risk of lung collapse and pneumonia.
**What differentiates Tietze from costochondritis?** Visible swelling.
**A patient has lower rib pain with a click when bending. Which test?** Hooking manoeuvre.
**Why avoid tight chest binding?** It restricts breathing and increases pneumonia risk.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Screen chest wall pain for cardiac and respiratory causes.
Perform rib compression, spring and hooking tests.
Manage rib fracture with a respiratory focus.

sections.A: Pasliyan peeche reedh se aur aage seene ki haddi se cartilage ke zariye juri hain. Dard dono siroon par ho sakta hai: rib dysfunction, costochondritis ya fracture.
sections.B: Ek jagah tez dard jo dabane par wapas aata hai, gehri saans, khansi, chheenk ya mudne par barhta hai, aur mehnat ya bukhar se juda nahi.
sections.C: Chot ya girna, mehnat par dard, saans phoolna, khoon wali khansi aur bukhar ke baare mein zaroor poochein.
sections.D: Seene ke dard mein pehle vital signs. Phir dekhein, har jor aur pasli dabayein, aur saans par dard check karein.
sections.E: Jor dabana, pasliyon ko aage-peeche aur side se dabana, aur hooking test dard ki jagah dhoondte hain.
sections.F: Dil ka attack, phephron ka collapse, pneumonia aur fracture ko pehle rule out karein.
sections.G: Paseene aur baazu ya jabre tak dard, chot ke baad achanak saans ki takleef, ya kai pasliyon ka fracture: emergency.
sections.H: Seene ka dard ho to pehle dil aur saans ki wajah dekhein, phir fracture. Ek jagah ka dard jo dabane par aaye aur koi doosri wajah na ho to musculoskeletal.
sections.I: Costochondritis ka asal ilaaj samjhana hai, yeh bezarar hai aur hafton mein theek hota hai. Fracture mein saans ki exercise zaroori hai.
sections.L: Gehri saans par dard, dabane par dard aur kaam ki salahiyat track karein. Fracture aam taur par 6 hafte mein judta hai.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Yaad rakhein: sirf dabane par dard costochondritis sabit nahi karta; pehle dil ki wajah rule out karein.
